title: Repeated claim: regional road deaths 'down 40 per cent'
summary: Senator Natarajan repeated in the Senate a claim first checked in January 2026. This claim has previously been checked. The updated August 2026 series records a 13 per cent reduction.

title: Evidence updated: regional road deaths series
summary: The August 2026 release of the monthly series was added to the record for the January 2026 claim. Classification unchanged: contradicted by evidence.

title: New claim: Silvergum hospital 'has lost 200 beds since 2020'
summary: Statement in the House on 28 September 2026. Classified insufficient evidence: published data covers only 2020–21 to 2024–25 and shows a 64-bed reduction.

title: Clarification: net overseas migration 'at record levels'
summary: Mr Oyelaran clarified on 29 September 2026 that he was referring to the three-year cumulative total. Correction behaviour recorded as 'clarified'.

title: Updated claim: rents growing at slowest rate since 2020
summary: Senator Natarajan restated the claim using the revised September release. Correction behaviour recorded as 'updated'.

title: Classification changed: rents claim moved from 'contradicted' to 'mixed'
summary: The September 2026 revision of the rental price index changed the evidence. The earlier assessment remains on the record; see the corrections log.

title: New claim: GP bulk-billing rate 'rose to 79 per cent'
summary: Media release of 27 August 2026. Classified supported.

title: New claim: regulator's chair 'privately' said price cap would be lifted
summary: Television interview of 20 August 2026. Classified unverifiable: it describes a private conversation.

title: Clarification: break-ins in Wattle Plains 'doubled'
summary: Mr Oyelaran said he should have said break-ins had 'risen sharply, not doubled'. Correction behaviour recorded as 'clarified'.

title: Investigation opened: Regional Connectivity Grants round 3
summary: The National Integrity Commission announced a formal investigation. The commission notes that commencement is not a finding.

title: Complaint dismissed: pre-election advertisement
summary: The Electoral Commission found the advertisement was properly authorised and dismissed the complaint.

title: Official finding: electorate office mailing
summary: The Parliamentary Expenses Authority found a minor breach, required repayment of $1,240 and found no dishonest intent.

title: Police confirm investigation into allegation against Hugh Castellan MP
summary: Police confirmed a report was received and an investigation is under way. Current status: police investigation — no charges laid — no finding of guilt. Mr Castellan denies the allegation.

title: Correction: household disposable income 'fallen 8 per cent'
summary: Mr Oyelaran corrected the figure to 'around 5 per cent in real per-capita terms' and issued an amended transcript.

title: New claim: regional road fatalities 'fallen by 40 per cent'
summary: Press conference of 4 January 2026. Classified contradicted by evidence: the official series records a 12 per cent reduction.

title: Cleared: family trust interest declaration
summary: The House Committee of Privileges and Members' Interests found the interest was declared within the required period and that no breach occurred.

title: Investigation closed: no charges laid — Senator Isla Fenwick
summary: Police announced that no charges would be laid over the 2022 campaign event allegation. Current status: no charges laid — no finding of guilt.
